about_the_game:
Welcome to your Soukh!

In our debut title, Soukh, you play as an exiled merchant striving to rebuild his legacy by running a bazaar in his hometown. It blends light strategy, management sim mechanics, and quirky minigames, all wrapped in a rich fantasy world, with an Middle Eastern/Asian inspired artstyle!

Meet the Merchant

Exiled from a wealthy home, family and lifestyle, follow the Merchant's story, as he leaves the rich and lucrative Bazhi Empire and ends up back in his barren hometown. Watch his story unfold as he meets some old allies, and some new ones, as he rebuilds his Soukh, and the hometown with him.

Manage your Soukh!

 Introducing a unique shop-keeping experience, similar to how real-life Soukhs work! Set the right price, engage actively with customers, haggle and manage your items in a chaotic environment filled with impatient characters, thieves and so much more!

Send out Caravans!

The world of Lazaran is huge, and filled with many resources that can help you make a profit. Hire a roster of adventurers, scouts and healers to send out on expeditions, and assist them with challenges they might face along the way. Gain legendary loot ( or even stolen goods) and watch the gold pour in!

Turn Rot into Royalty.

Explore your hometown, with unique buildings filled with interesting characters! Help out your allies along the way, and upgrade your tiny deserted village into a bustling bazaar town!

Features 

  • 🪙Manage a fun and chaotic market where item prices matter

  • ⚖️Sell high by haggling with fun minigames

  • 🦊Hire new roster members and upgrade them to advanced classes

  • 🎲Mini-games tied to each type of expeditions sent

  • 🎨Wonderful hand-crafted visuals

  • 👳‍♂️Meet dozens of unique customers, characters throughout your story

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Above
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD A8-5600k
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 630 / Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Above
  • Processor: Intel i5-650 / Ryzen 3 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 2060/ Radeon HD 7510
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

short_description: Discover Soukh - a Middle Eastern-inspired fantasy shopkeeping and strategy game. Run a chaotic bazaar with demanding customers, dispatch caravans and conquer challenges to gather exotic loot. Guide an exiled merchant’s rise. Will the sands lift him to glory… or bury him in stories left untold?
